decision_scope: Raw measurement export only. The completed section-3-table decision rule (docs/stage-7b-signed-bracket-preregistration.md section 3, replacing only the joint-supercriticality pairing precondition of docs/stage-7b2-preregistration.md section 5 as carried) is applied exactly once by the source-frozen reducer reduce_stage7b_signed_bracket.py; nothing here establishes fitness, selection, an optimum, an ESS, or any external-validation mechanism.
evidence_class: seeded, mutation-disabled confirmatory population suite under exogenous phenotype-blind hazard at the carried section 3 ecology (N=48, E=900, W=1200); endpoint measured with the unchanged two-factor coefficients (l^A_x * m^E_x); solver certified on the FULL real line; decision deferred to the reducer
execution_class: one seeded confirmatory suite (signed-bracket prereg section 6.3), executed once after the section 5 gate passed and the section 6 freeze committed

integrity.ledgers_asserted_every_operation: live ledgers verified after every operation; full immutable history rescanned at every tick-complete checkpoint (stage7b2_population.assert_all_ledgers)

registered_configuration.carried_from: docs/stage-7b2-repair-preregistration.md section 3 ecology, carried verbatim through the endpoint-repair and denominator-repair preregistrations
registered_configuration.endpoint: two-factor Euler-Lotka coefficients c_x = l^A_x * m^E_x: risk-set window-actuarial survivorship l^A_{x+1} = l^A_x*(E_x-d_x)/E_x times per-capita person-tick fecundity m^E_x = n_x/E_x
registered_configuration.endpoint_supersedes: the collapsed coefficient assembly c_x = l_x*m_x = n_x/|C_g| (shared cohort-size denominator set) of docs/stage-7b-endpoint-repair-preregistration.md section 3, per denominator-repair prereg sections 2-3
registered_configuration.mediator_note: the establishment/first-reproduction quantity is reported as a mediator and is never substituted for the endpoint
registered_configuration.shakedown_table: 24 fixed seeds 20270000 + j, j in 0..23, reused verbatim a fourth time across all gate generations (signed-bracket prereg section 5.2)
registered_configuration.solver_domain: full real line: L(0) > 1 -> SUPERCRITICAL (bracket >= 0); L(0) == 1 exact -> CRITICAL (bracket [0,0]); L(0) < 1 with S_plus > 0 -> SUBCRITICAL (certified negative bracket); S_plus == 0, or c_0 >= 1 with S_plus > 0 -> NO_FINITE_ROOT
registered_configuration.solver_domain_supersedes: the L(0) <= 1 => SUBCRITICAL/no-numeric-r_g rule of docs/stage-7b2-preregistration.md section 4 steps 1-2, as carried through every prior Stage 7B generation
registered_configuration.supersedes: m_x normalisation of docs/stage-7b-endpoint-repair-preregistration.md section 3 as inherited from docs/stage-7b1-preregistration.md section 6.1
